I am a 41-year-old woman farming my own 1.30-hectare plot here in Mtwara. The rains have been unpredictable, but maize still feeds my family, so I will plant improved seed from the agro-dealer because it gives better yield even with the little fertilizer I can afford. I will put some DAP and urea on the plot — not too much because the money is tight — but I will do the weeding myself with my children since hiring help for the whole season is costly, though I may need a few extra hands at harvest time. There is no irrigation here; we depend on the rains, and I do not have manure or compost to spread.
